newsitem.title: USA: Escalon gets laser technology patents.
newsitem.headline: Escalon gets laser technology patents.

text.p: Escalon Medical Corp said Wednesday that the U.S. Trademark and Patent Office has issued two new patents related to the company's picosecond laser technology, being developed for refractive eye surgery and other applications in medicine.
Escalon said the Trademark and Patent Office also provided a Notice of Allowance on a third related patent.
The company said its current ultrafast lasers use picosecond (one-trillionth of a second) technology.

According to the company, this short-pulse, high repetition, lower energy delivery of the laser beam has the potential for increased precision during intraocular microsurgery and causes less collateral tissue damage.

Although Escalon is developing picosecond lasers for ophthalmic applications, most of its patents also include femtosecond (one thousand times faster than a picosecond) applications, the company said.
